notes: Public anonymous sessions only; no cookies, CSRF tokens, account details, ad request query strings or bulk third-party question text in this file.
One completion path per ordinary quiz; mobile result checks reopened the public result URL.
selectedIndex is zero based. Initial sweep chose catalog zero-based index modulo choice count; six follow-up completions chose the first option.
Text hashes normalize whitespace, then use SHA-256. Follow-up answer labels were not retained; null hashes do not imply missing answers.
Snapshots may change. Public result URLs and hashes identify observed evidence, not a promise that the service will preserve it.
